title: I AM SUING THEM!
body: They charged me twice (29,99USD)!!! Then every three day they wanted to charged me again for 29,99 USD. I needed to go on police and in bank and sue them to stop. They do not respond on email and they do not have page where you can unsubscribe. Total idiots and scam! Do not take this !!!!
author: Nowayno999

title: Total disaster app and service, a scam
body:
They charge 1 euro for a 3 day service. If you are unhappy with service there is no way to cancel subscription in the app and they take forever to answer your email, so time have passed and they will not refund your money. Do not use premium service, they are a scam.

I feel cheated, because before the 3 day trial was over, I looked for ways to cancel the service in the app and I could not find it. When I finally wrote an email to customer service they took a long time to answer only to inform me they can not refund my money. I am so dissapointed with the app and the dishonest customer service. I was never denied a refund before for an unsatisfactory product.
author: Koraljka de Carina
